title: IH-10 at Highway 87

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located at the northeast quadrant of IH-10 and Highway 87 in Comfort, Texas.

rows.label: Frontage
rows.text: There is substantial public road frontage on all parcels. See Survey.

rows.label: Utilities
pairs: Service is provided by Bandera Electric Cooperative.
KCWCID has an 8-inch main on the east side of Highway 87 in front of the property.
KCWCID sewer main is at the east corner of IH-10 and Highway 87 in front of Love’s Travel Center.
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility and capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.text: None. City of Comfort is unincorporated and has no zoning code.
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Topography
rows.text: Lot 3 has gentle southerly drainage. Lots 1 and 2 have more noticeable slope draining south to IH-10.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: According to Risk Meter Online flood maps, there does not appear to be any flood plain on the parcels.

rows.label: Easements
rows.text: The parcels have some utility easements and a private road easement. Contact Broker.

rows.label: Deed Restrictions
rows.text: Some restrictions benefiting the Love’s Travel Center are in place. Contact Broker.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: The 2024 Texas Department of Transportation traffic count maps indicate 11.558 vehicles per day on Highway 87 near the property, 26,476 vehicles per day on IH-10 West just east of Highway 87 and 18,268 vehicles per day on IH-10 just west of Highway 87.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025 and 2030.

rows.label: Area Development
rows.text: The property’s major intersection location includes two convenience stores and a Love’s Travel Center. A James Avery manufacturing facility is on the north border of Lot 3.

rows.label: Potential Use
rows.text: Excellent opportunity for commercial, restaurant and light industrial uses. Access to utilities, including sewer, afford an opportunity for a multifamily project or other uses.

comments: The properties lie within the Kendall County Water Control and Improvement District No. 1 service area.
There is a house and small barn on Lot 3.

qa_notes: Traffic Count typo: '11.558 vehicles per day on Highway 87' uses a period instead of a comma (presumably 11,558). Kept verbatim; broker should correct.
Transaction: the PDF never says For Sale or For Lease ('Investment: Contact Broker'); 'For Sale' used per schema default. Prismic transaction_type is null.

Size is a lot breakdown with an 'Acres:' column header, transcribed as a table (Lot 1 3.917 + Lot 2 6.22 + Lot 3 34.69 = 44.827, printed total 44.83 Acres — consistent). The survey (p6) labels the same three tracts 3.917 / 6.22 / 34.69 ACRES. Total matches Prismic size_label '44.83 acres' / acres 44.83.
No size line on the cover, so size_headline is empty. Cover title reads 'IH-10 AT HIGHWAY 87' (hyphenated); Prismic title is 'IH 10 at Highway 87, Comfort' (no hyphen, city appended).

Zoning MISMATCH: PDF says 'None. City of Comfort is unincorporated and has no zoning code.'; Prismic zoning says 'Outside City of Comfort'. (Also the PDF's phrase 'City of Comfort is unincorporated' is self-contradictory — Comfort is an unincorporated community, not a city.)
Variant 'land' chosen although Comments note 'There is a house and small barn on Lot 3' — the offering is marketed as commercial/development land, so the improvements are incidental.
Utilities lists only Electric, Water and Sewer (no Gas line).
Grammar: Potential Use 'Access to utilities, including sewer, afford an opportunity' (subject/verb agreement: 'affords'). Kept verbatim.
Prismic highlights ('Great commercial corner!', 'There is a house and small barn on Lot 3.') match two of the three PDF comments; the Kendall County WCID No. 1 comment is not in Prismic.
Contact order on this listing is Matt Howard first ('MATT HOWARD or BART WILSON'), with mhoward@ email listed first.
